For each exponent below one a fixed coordinate creates an asymptotically negative H at arbitrarily small other coordinate. For a,b>=1, the bijective (r,s) transform reduces global nonnegativity to two explicitly minimized one-variable functions; all endpoint limits and phi=0 are handled. The exact rational checker independently verifies special thresholds and positive/negative witnesses; finite checks are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: An exact natural parameter-classification problem for a recently proposed bivariate failure-dependence model. It prevents use of a non-copula in reliability calculations, identifies all superunit asymmetric admissible parameters, and supplies a sharp coupling cap and subunit nonexistence boundary. This is structural model-validity information, not an arbitrary numerical threshold or renaming.
